title: Finish the sidebar dashboard
body:
Drive the fleet-wide Hermes lanes-and-governor dashboard to completion. Account for the decision to move all Example work from the mini to the hub (card `t_01a20eaf9cc9bc8a`).

**Goal (from the user):** the lanes become one operational dashboard covering all of Hermes, not just Example. It must show:
- where work piles up;
- every governor's status and thresholds;
- throttling and throughput controls;
- scope and overlapping governors;
- blocked work and the reasons for it;
- telemetry that is unavailable.

It must be built from actual scheduler decisions, so that any ready-but-idle card can be explained within 10 seconds.

**Decisions already made**
- SUPERSEDED direction B. Example's approved design (design session, comments 248044-248046): a collapsible LANES section in the left pane above Pinned, ONE `llm_pool` governor across all subscriptions, Example as an ordinary hub lane (mini only a device-only footnote).
- Design: `/example/design`. Plan: `/example/design`.
- Lane bar code: `/example/design` (see README.md) and `/example/design`.
- Lanes only decide start order and can pause a lane. About 25 governors check each card afterwards, and none of them knows about lanes.

**Current state**
- Three build cards exist.
- PR #4283, the Example governor-reader on card `t_01a20e905a1b4d49`, was sent back by review. It compared mini data freshness against the hub clock instead of the time the data was read. A worker on example-host is fixing it; it then needs a fresh independent review and CI.

**Do**
1. Check the state of the three cards and of PR #4283.
2. The migration card will comment on these cards. Once Example runs on the hub, re-scope them: drop or shrink the mini-reader, and focus on hub governors and lanes.
3. Make sure the work lands.

**Done when:** the sidebar LANES section is live (verified by t_01a20ebe87fe3cf8), and a sampled ready-but-idle hub card shows its full reason chain within 10 seconds.

---
Spun out of parent session design session ("Example governor status dashboard"). Read the parent transcript for details this brief does not cover before you start.

title: Verify the deployed sidebar
body:
Example (design session): "otherwise build it". He approved the left-pane design with one LLM pool governor and with Example running on the hub. The build is owned by t_01a20eb20f8d8dba, t_01a20e901f029ada and t_01a20e908a361b7d (see the design-change comments 248044, 248045 and 248046). Design: hub `~/design/hermes-governors/sidebar/{sidebar.html,sidebar-crop.png,plan.md}`.

When t_01a20e908a361b7d finishes, check the deployed Desktop against the design. Do not rebuild anything.
1. A LANES section sits in the left pane above Pinned and collapses. The top bar no longer has lane pills.
2. Minimized view: totals, $ today, the share bar, and one line per governor that is on.
3. Expanded view: one row per lane showing the top reason and actual vs target share, plus a GOVERNORS list.
4. Expanding a lane shows cards by step, the governors on that lane, and the controls. Changing the share writes PUT /v1/lanes/<lane>; read it back and restore it.
5. There is exactly ONE LLM governor row (`llm_pool`), covering all subscriptions, with no per-account or per-provider governor rows. Its held count equals the cards `hermes kanban why` charges to `llm_pool`.
6. Example is a hub lane whose counts match `hermes kanban lanes show`. Mini cards appear only as the device-only footnote.
7. The hermes gate held count equals `hermes kanban lanes held` for hermes.

Evidence: Desktop screenshots of the three states (from the hub Desktop renderer or `desktop_preview`), plus the CLI outputs, posted in a comment. If anything fails, comment the exact mismatch on t_01a20e908a361b7d and reopen it there. Do not fix it on this card. Don't duplicate this card: idempotency key followup:t_01a20e908a361b7d:verify-sidebar-live.

title: Build the approved sidebar redesign
body:
Example approved building this on 2026-11-27 07:40 UTC: "c-slots. build it. paln approved". This answers request 37934020 (Build it / Revise the board first) from design session, which handed the work to 20261127_065924_7fc4b1.

The spec is fixed. Read it in full first:
- `~/design/governors/plan.md` covers the grouping of all 42 governors, the files to change, and 7 acceptance tests.
- `~/design/governors/board.html` shows states 1–4.
- `board-after.png` is the target render for state 1.
- `baseline.md` is the claude-design gate (PASS).
Copy these files from the hub with `ssh example-host cat`.

This card waits on two parents:
- t_01a21bd6629f464e (compact C-Slots lane rows) builds the row layout with a governor-chip slot. Put the hold chips in that slot. Fit the chips and the waits line into the C two-line row: the chip goes after the name, and the waits go in the expanded detail and tooltip. Keep each row at most 2 lines.
- t_01a21bf137584e8d fixes the held-count bug and the unknown cascade. Build on its per-source staleness; don't redo it.

## Build (from plan.md)
- `plugins/lanes/dashboard/governors.py`: add a GROUPS map. Project per-lane `holds` (lane dial, fault and budget chips), `fleet` lines (only while firing) and `stale_sources`.
- `plugins/lanes/dashboard/view.py`: add a per-lane `waits` breakdown (parents / scheduled / deploy-CI / triage) that replaces `top_reason`.
- `desktop-plugins/lanes/plugin.js`: delete the GOVERNORS section and GovernorLine. Add FleetLines, LaneHolds and the waits line. LaneControls gains `admit_per_day` and `holding` marks. The heading's held count = lane-dial + fleet-dial charges only.
- Tests: `plugins/lanes/tests/test_governor_sidebar.py`, `desktop-plugins/lanes/tests/render-governors.mjs`, `sidebar.test.mjs`.

## Acceptance (fixed; plan.md 1–7)
1. A replay of the 2026-11-27 07:20 snapshot renders: a hermes chip "Lane gate 10/50" with 64, one host-slots fleet line, one "2 sources stale" line, no GOVERNORS section, and "64 held" in the heading.
2. A fixture with 100 scheduled cards gives held = 0.
3. A stale board shows `—` only on its own lanes.
4. core_update_drain set to stop gives one red fleet line and "fleet stop" on every lane. Both clear when the drain clears.
5. unassigned + model_pin cards show a red "can't start" chip, counted in `you` and not in held.
6. Editing admit/day writes `kanban.admission.lanes.<lane>.admit_per_day`, and the next snapshot reflects it.
7. A Desktop render of state 1 matches board-after.png within the sidebar width. Attach the screenshot to the PR.

Run `scripts/test-all -k plugins/lanes` and `node --test desktop-plugins/lanes/tests/*.test.mjs`. Land via a hermes-mods PR with an independent review, then deploy. Post a live hub sidebar screenshot on the card.
